item.title: Raiders bring back former assistant with ties to 2025 No. 1 pick
item.description: Klint Kubiak has added another offensive coach who has previous experience in the organization and has a chance to work with the top overall selection in the draft for a second consecutive year.

item.title: ‘We weren’t ready to play’: Cassidy gives blunt assessment of Knights’ latest loss
item.description: After losing to the Washington Capitals on Friday, Golden Knights coach Bruce Cassidy said the players must take responsibility for not being prepared.

item.title: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak set to make major addition to offense
item.description: One of the holes the new coach of the Las Vegas Raiders has to fill on his first roster is a position that didn’t even exist on the team last season.

item.title: UNLV basketball preview: Rebels to host in-state rival UNR
item.description: The UNLV men’s basketball team looks to improve its seeding for the Mountain West conference tournament with a win against UNR on Saturday night.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Bus camera ticketing scheme doesn’t hold up under scrutiny
